subject: silken-embrace
q: The Concierge tablet is still running v7. What does it show under v8?
detail:
The Silken Embrace document is a v7 rebuild and its specification list says so out loud. THE FIELDS IT SHARES ARE: Build Class primary and secondary, Ass/Hip Archetype primary and secondary out of thirteen, and the five automatic outputs — HMM, TDM, BAS, GG, AMD — plus measurements, height and cock specs.

UNDER v8 AT LEAST THREE OF THOSE MOVE. Build Class loses Junoesque and Petite to STATURE, so the tablet needs a stature field it does not have. The thirteen archetypes become the seven-field lower body — Shape, Scale, Handfeel, Distribution and Carriage, Motion, Exact Refinement, Devotion Tell — which is MORE useful to a garment cutter, not less: handfeel and motion are exactly what a fabric has to answer to. And the five derived outputs have no stated v8 status at all.

TWO THINGS SURVIVE UNTOUCHED AND SHOULD. THIGH DENSITY still organises the boot wall, because a shaft width is a shaft width. And the FITTING ROOM POLICY has no version number on it.

ONE ERA-ARTIFACT WORTH NAMING: the document's own class list reads Junoesque, Athletic, Petite, Seductress, Ethereal, Huntress — SIX, missing Valkyrie and Dancer. That predates even v7's eight. The shop's paperwork has been behind the system it is wired into for at least two versions, which is realistic and is not an error to correct.

ANSWERED 7 SEPTEMBER by the v8 Lower Body document's own Silken Embrace section. RETIRED.
